amendment.reason: The archive at the pinned revision turned out to carry Git LFS pointer stubs for src/data/** and *.png rather than payloads. One labeled deviation extended the allowlist to https://media.githubusercontent.com/media/factoriolab/factoriolab/<pinned-commit-sha>/<lfs-path> — plain GET, no credentials, each payload verified against the sha256 oid carried by the pointer it replaces. Recorded in lfs.json and probe-ledger.ndjson.
